# Ezekiel 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "Now, son of man, get a clay brick and set it in front of you. Scratch a picture of the city of Jerusalem on it.

**2** Then lay siege to it — build siege walls, pile up an assault ramp, set up army camps around it, and place battering rams against it on every side.

**3** Then take an iron griddle and set it up as an iron wall between you and the city. Face the city and put it under siege. This will be a sign to the people of Israel.

**4** Now lie on your left side and take the sin of Israel upon yourself. You will bear their sin for as many days as you lie there.

**5** I am assigning you 390 days, one day for each year of their sin. That is how long you will bear the sin of Israel.

**6** When those days are over, turn over and lie on your right side for 40 days — one day for each year — to bear the sin of Judah.

**7** Face the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.

**8** I will tie you up with ropes so you can't turn from one side to the other until the days of your siege are finished.

**9** Now, gather wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt. Mix them in a single bowl and bake bread from them. This is what you'll eat during the 390 days you lie on your side.

**10** You are allowed only eight ounces of food per day, and you may eat only at set times.

**11** You may drink only two-thirds of a quart of water per day, at set times.

**12** Bake the bread like a barley cake — using dried human dung as fuel, with everyone watching."

**13** Then the LORD said, "This is how the people of Israel will eat their food — contaminated — among the nations where I will scatter them."

**14** I cried out, "Lord GOD, no! I have never been defiled! From the time I was young until now, I have never eaten an animal that died naturally or was killed by wild beasts. I have never let any unclean meat touch my lips!"

**15** "All right," He said. "I will let you use cow dung instead of human dung for baking your bread."

**16** Then He said, "Son of man, I am going to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will ration their food with fear and measure their water with dread.

**17** Food and water will run out. They will stare at each other in horror and slowly waste away because of their sins.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **4:1-3**: God tells Ezekiel to play out the coming siege of Jerusalem in miniature — scratching the city on a brick, building tiny siege works around it. It's street theater with a devastating message.

- **4:9-12**: Starvation rations made from a desperate mix of grains, baked over dung — this isn't just symbolic. This is exactly what people in a besieged city would experience. Ezekiel is living the prophecy.

- **4:14-15**: This is one of the few times a prophet successfully pushes back on God — and God actually changes the terms. Ezekiel's priestly conscience is respected even when he's being pushed to the edge.

— PNEUMA
